Video over Wi‑Fi, music over car Bluetooth. Off by default — music stays on Android Auto Wi‑Fi. Turn on if Wi‑Fi music stutters. Keep the phone paired to car Bluetooth. Reconnect Android Auto after changing this.
Connect the phone to the car Bluetooth for music and calls (hybrid mode). Otherwise they may stay on the phone.

Hybrid needs car Bluetooth (A2DP + phone/HFP). If Bluetooth is off, music, calls and Gemini can stay on the phone while Android Auto video still works. Assistant/nav audio still use Android Auto (not Wi‑Fi music).

Trying music over Wi‑Fi: DiAuto disconnects car Bluetooth music (A2DP) so it does not mix with Wi‑Fi audio. Turn on AAC, raise the Wi‑Fi media buffer (1000–1500 ms), and keep a moderate frame rate. If it still stutters, switch back to Music through car Bluetooth.

Test: when Android Auto connects (hybrid on), ask the car media service to select Bluetooth Music — same as the home-screen music card. SAIC / MG. Off by default.
